data.body: DD1 IMPLEMENTED (loop, 2026-06-05), TDD, regression-free. Rebase-not-merge end-to-end in merge-to-main-pr.sh: Site A (PR1 step-5 fallback ~1118) --merge->--rebase; Site C (_phase_queue_auto_merge ~1409) --auto --merge->--auto --rebase; Site E (PR2 poll-fallback ~2195) --merge->--rebase; Site D (KEYSTONE, pre-push default-branch sync ~1180) extracted into _sync_branch_against_default(), local 'git merge --no-edit origin/<default>' -> 'git rebase', sets _SYNCED_VIA_REBASE=1 so publish uses --force-with-lease (avoids replaying rewritten commits onto stale origin/<branch> and doubling them). This is what makes 'gh pr merge --rebase' viable (a merge commit in PR head makes GitHub's rebase-merge refuse the PR). Scope: STORY_PR_BASE/ci-pr path (inject_and_enable_automerge F/H/I ~2943/2972/2981) is a SEPARATE flow w/ DSO-Story-Merge merge-commit-trailer invariant, NOT 'PR1 and PR2' -> noted follow-up. prebump-sync (0f17) needs NO change (already rebases onto pinned main). Tests: NEW test-merge-to-main-linear-sync.sh 4/4 (D1 linear+0-merge-commits+flag, D2 up-to-date noop, D3 conflict abort-restore, D4 unrelated skip); updated t_pr_auto_merge_queued + t_auto_merge_disabled_invokes_manual_merge_in_poll assert --rebase + never --merge. Regression sweep clean (prebump 5/5, staged-intermediate 11/11, version-bump 22/22, locking 25/25, session-push 5/5). Pre-existing unrelated fails (fail on original script too): t_emit_local_escalation_includes_next_action, auto-resolve 9F, cleanliness 11F. REMAINING: DD3 pending user decision (delete vs demote-to-tripwire; safeguard files); DD2 required_linear_history ruleset 15629023 = admin/go-live (lintest/** first); DD4 live-verify needs DD2. L8 written proof NOT in-repo (construct + confirm on lintest/**).
